CaptureRuntime performs externally scheduled bounded reopen recovery, preserves sequence continuity and contains no internal unbounded retry/sleep loop; Ubuntu run 34504968258 and Windows run 34504968283 passed

IMMNotificationClient callback registration runs on a dedicated Windows MTA thread and publishes to a bounded non-blocking queue with drop accounting; Ubuntu run 34508512647 and Windows run 34508512649 passed, including Windows register/unregister smoke

Owner-thread notification bridge triggers at most one recovery transition for a relevant active capture route change while unrelated/same-default events remain no-ops; Ubuntu run 34509104650 and Windows run 34509104681 passed

VirtualMicStagingBuffer provides fixed-format bounded user-mode virtual-mic staging, drops oldest data on overflow to bound latency, emits fresh silence on underrun and tracks accepted/drop/underrun counters; Ubuntu run 34522446261 and Windows run 34522445865 passed
VirtualMicOutputBridge sends both successfully processed frames and AudioPipeline safe-bypass originals into the same staging path; Ubuntu run 34522943083 and Windows run 34522943093 passed

Versioned C-compatible virtual microphone transport protocol defines magic/version/header sizing, session generation, fixed audio geometry and monotonic producer/consumer cursors; cyclic ring planning normalizes overruns by discarding oldest frames. Ubuntu run 34525486454 and Windows run 34525486333 passed on implementation head aa0792b81746a11d99b3b3451c3086e363714ee8

MSVC x64 C++ driver-facing ABI mirror in native/windows-virtual-mic locks 40-byte ProtocolHeader/CursorSnapshot sizes, 8-byte alignment, exact field offsets, protocol validation and matching cyclic-ring/session/cursor semantics; Ubuntu run 34528681411 and Windows run 34528681382 passed on implementation head 93c166709e3fad6aecd924a0378316761a9e318f

Windows x64 shared-cursor synchronization uses aligned Interlocked 64-bit publication, bounded stable snapshots, session-generation fencing, monotonic producer/consumer checks and atomic overrun/underrun counters; Ubuntu run 34530771449 and Windows run 34530771628 passed on implementation head 29df8cf88878f14ec319e249562f3d25aa2efe30

Deterministic 64-byte-aligned shared-region planning defines header/cursor/PCM-ring offsets and overflow-safe total mapping sizing; the 48 kHz mono F32 10 ms four-frame reference is 7,808 bytes total. Ubuntu run 34531204947 and Windows run 34531204951 passed on implementation head fafd5100d430d0880fe1dfe0671edf7537683fcf

Custom topology/WaveRT miniports, PortCls subdevice registration and physical bridge wiring, a concrete WaveRT capture stream and guarded transport bridge are present in native/windows-virtual-mic and compile in the real WDK target
